_comment: World events. Templates are content; live instances live in GameState. Price multipliers and vital deltas are derived from the active set (they vanish when the event ends). Stock shocks are one-shot writes to the shelf, because goods do not teleport back. A template may name goods or whole categories. A shortage names reliefStanding: a convoy that sells that good into the city while the event runs earns that much citizen standing per reliefUnits sold. {city} {region} {governor} {good} {category} are filled when the dispatch is built.

events.name: Mill walkout
events.headline: Walkout at the {city} mills
events.detail: Shifts have stopped. Refined metal and plating are dear until the floor goes back to work.

events.name: Cave-in
events.headline: Cave-in at {city}
events.detail: A shaft is lost. Ore has left the shelf and will take days to dig out.

events.name: Grid strain
events.headline: {city} grid runs short
events.detail: The plant cannot keep the city in cells. What is left on the shelf is priced as a shortage.

events.name: Bumper harvest
events.headline: Bumper harvest around {city}
events.detail: The granaries are full. Rations are cheap and the books look healthier.

events.name: Trade fair
events.headline: Trade fair opens in {city}
events.detail: Houses are buying components. Servos and sensors fetch a premium while the stalls are up.

events.name: Street unrest
events.headline: Unrest in {city}
events.detail: {governor} has the streets to think about. The city is no quieter for it.

events.name: Sensor orders
events.headline: Sensor orders flood {city}
events.detail: Precision works cannot keep up. Optical sensors are bid up across the floor.

events.name: Yard overflow
events.headline: {city} yards overflow
events.detail: Salvage has nowhere to go. Scrap is cheap on the shelf until the heaps are bought down.

events.name: Cell scare
events.headline: Power-cell scare across the continent
events.detail: A rumour of shortage has every city paying up for cells, plant town or not.

events.name: Ward shortage
events.headline: {city} wards run out of {category}
events.detail: The clinics are rationing. Anything medical sells at a shortage price, and the streets remember who brings it.

events.name: Tool famine
events.headline: {city} works floors short of {category}
events.detail: Worn kit and nothing to replace it. Tools fetch a shortage price until somebody hauls some in.

events.name: Board shortage
events.headline: {city} lines starved of {category}
events.detail: Boards and chips have run dry on the assembly lines. Electronics are bid up until the shelves refill.

events.name: Lean season
events.headline: {city} granaries run low on {category}
events.detail: The city is eating through its stores. Provisions sell dear and every sack unloaded is remembered.

events.name: Brownout
events.headline: {city} browns out for want of {category}
events.detail: Cells and fuel are rationed. The whole energy shelf is priced as a shortage.

events.name: Machine glut
events.headline: {city} floors overflow with {category}
events.detail: The shops built more than anyone ordered. Parts and drives are cheap until the yard clears.

events.name: Mill overrun
events.headline: {city} mills overrun with {category}
events.detail: Steel and stock pile up on the loading bays. Metals go cheap until the surplus is bought down.

events.name: Kiln overrun
events.headline: {city} kilns overrun with {category}
events.detail: Plate and glass stack up past the yard gate. Ceramics go cheap until the heaps move.
